answer: Vouches decay. Each edge loses weight whenever the recruit makes a claim no auditor confirms, so a lagoon of idle accounts keeps no strong thread for a whole voyage. Checks run on signed receipts in the client, and a repeated payload is caught by replay, not by name. Naive designs count sign-ups. This counts surviving vouches. A 500-account farm must keep 500 edges alive across epochs before it earns one payout.
